assertions.assertion: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat without a clear precipitating factor
The symptoms are of a non-sustained nature
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture potential arrhythmic events over a prolonged monitoring period
The diagnosis codes I49.9 and R00.2 support the need for extended rhythm correlation
The appeal provides the required clinical justification for medical necessity of this diagnostic procedure
